# events-spring: dated events Jan 1 - Apr 30, 2027 and the annual signature calendar

Checked 2026-09-27. 47 dated events (Jan 15, Feb 12, Mar 10, Apr 10) and 66 series records. Validator clean.

## What is covered

**Dated events (only where the organizer, or a producer/listing named below, publishes a 2027 date):**
- Gasparilla season: Ashley Children's Gasparilla (Jan 23), Seminole Hard Rock Gasparilla Pirate Fest invasion and Parade of Pirates (Jan 30), Outbound Voyage (Feb 27), 57th Gasparilla Festival of the Arts (Mar 6-7), Gasparilla International Film Festival (Apr 1-4).
- Fairs: Florida State Fair (Feb 4-15, per-day hours as occurrences), Florida Strawberry Festival (Mar 4-14), Florida RV SuperShow (Jan 13-17).
- Heritage and community: Epiphany in Tarpon Springs (Jan 6, tentative), St. Pete MLK Parade (40th, Jan 18), Plant City MLK Festival (Jan 15-18), Kumquat Festival (Dade City, Jan 30), Tampa Bay Black Heritage Festival's Run For Us 5K (Feb 7), Localtopia (Feb 20), Gulfport Get Rescued (Feb 27), SPIFFS International Folk Fair (Mar 4-6), De Soto Children's Parade (Mar 26) and Grand Parade (Apr 24, Bradenton), Chasco Fiesta (Apr 9-17, New Port Richey), Tampa Riverfest (Apr 30-May 1).
- Festivals: Bay Area Renaissance Festival (Feb 6-Mar 21, tentative), Pigz in Z'Hills BBQ & Blues (Feb 6), Hondo Rodeo Fest (Feb 26-28, Raymond James Stadium), Pier 60 Sugar Sand Festival (Mar 26-Apr 11), SUN 'n FUN Aerospace Expo (Apr 6-11, Lakeland), Tampa Bay Blues Festival (Apr 9-11), Sarasota Film Festival (Apr 9-18), St. Petersburg Power and Sailboat Show (Jan 14-17), Pinellas TacoFest, four Paragon seafood and music festivals (Sarasota, Coquina Beach, St. Petersburg at Derby Lane, Manatee County).
- Art and craft shows: Mainsail (Apr 3-4), St. Petersburg Fine Art Festival, Tampa Fine Art Show (Hot Works), Sarasota and Lakewood Ranch art festivals (Paragon, Hot Works), Corey Avenue and Sponge Docks craft festivals, Pinellas Plant Festival.

**Series (the annual calendar), incl. summer and fall:** Gasparilla Pirate Fest, Children's Gasparilla, Sant' Yago Knight Parade, Gasparilla Festival of the Arts, Gasparilla International Film Festival, Gasparilla Music Festival, Epiphany, Florida State Fair, Florida Strawberry Festival, Tampa Bay Black Heritage Festival, Tampa, St. Pete and Plant City MLK parades, Fiesta Day (Ybor), River O'Green Fest (St. Patrick's), Tampa Pride, St. Pete Pride, Localtopia, Mainsail, Dunedin Highland Games, Clearwater Sea-Blues, Tampa Bay Collard Green Festival, Busch Gardens Food, Wine & Garden Festival, Sugar Sand, SUN 'n FUN, Chasco Fiesta, De Soto Heritage Festival, Tampa Bay Blues Festival, Tampa Riverfest, Boom by the Bay, The Fourth at the St. Pete Pier, Tampa Bay Comic Convention, GeckoFest, Clearwater Jazz Holiday, Tampa Pig Jig, Halloween on Central, Howl-O-Scream, Hillsborough County Fair, Tampa Greek Festival, SAVOR St. Pete, Tarpon Springs Seafood Festival, SHINE Mural Festival, Sanding Ovations, Siesta Key Crystal Classic, Sarasota Medieval Fair, Christmas Town, Santa Fest, Winter Village, Tampa Riverwalk and Alafia lighted boat parades, Sunsets at Pier 60, and markets (St. Pete Saturday Morning Market, Hyde Park Village Fresh Market, Gulfport Tuesday Fresh Market, Safety Harbor Sunday Market and 3rd Friday).

## How candidates were found
- Official tourism lists: Visit Tampa Bay Gasparilla-season, music-festival, Halloween and September pages, plus its public events API (Simpleview plugins_events_events/find with window and title filters; it rate-limited once); Visit St. Pete-Clearwater winter/spring/summer/fall festival pages and event listings (read with WebFetch; curl gets 403); Visit Florida's events API (statewide, filtered to the region).
- City lists: City of Tampa "City Yearly Events" (tampa.gov/info/feature-events) and Special Events pages; St. Petersburg "Major Events"; City of Safety Harbor calendar iCal feed; Clearwater parks events (JS, little usable).
- Festival producers' 2027 schedules: SIK Promotions (Pinellas craft and food festivals), Paragon Festivals (art and seafood festivals), Hot Works (art shows), Florida RV Trade Association, East Pasco Chamber, Friends of the Riverwalk; fair directories (renfest.org, therenlist.com) for the Renaissance festival.
- The Events Calendar REST API probed on about 25 local WordPress sites (Florida State Fairgrounds and St. Pete Pier answered; nothing major beyond the State Fair).
- WebSearch until the shared search budget ran out (about a third of the way in); after that, direct organizer URLs and the listings above.
- Every record's facts come from its source_url page, read on 2026-09-27; also_sources are pages used for secondary facts, named in notes. Coordinates from the research geocoder (census for addresses, photon for parks), checked against the matched text; approximate points are flagged in notes. 40 of 47 events have a place id or coordinates.

## Counts
- Events by kind: market 13, festival 10, parade 6, food-drink 6, cultural 3, fair 2, convention 2, film 2, boat-show 1, concert 1, run-walk 1. By region: Tampa 10, St. Petersburg 8, Gulf Beaches 3, Clearwater and North Pinellas 6, Around the Bay 6, Day Trips 13 (Sarasota, Bradenton, Lakeland), no area 1 (GIFF, venues not announced). Status: 45 scheduled, 2 tentative. Featured: 10.
- Series by kind: festival 20, parade 10, food-drink 7, holiday 6, market 6, fair 4, cultural 3, convention 3, concert 3, film 2, boat-show 1, fireworks 1. Featured: 20.

## Deliberately left out, and why
- Sports (Gasparilla Distance Classic, Grand Prix, Valspar, spring training, Lightning) belong to events-sports; concerts and theater runs to events-shows (the Hondo Rodeo Fest and Tampa Bay Blues Festival are included as festivals; dedupe with events-shows if needed). Sep-Dec 2026 dated events belong to events-fall; fall items appear here only as series.
- No 2027 date published, so series only (no event): Sant' Yago Knight Parade (krewe page still shows Feb 14, 2026), Gasparilla Music Festival ("DATE TBD"), Dunedin Highland Games (page shows Apr 11, 2026), Clearwater Sea-Blues, Collard Green Festival, Tampa MLK Parade, River O'Green Fest, Fiesta Day, Tampa Pride, Busch Gardens Food, Wine & Garden, The Fest @ Tampa Bay ("April 2027, details subject to change").
- Not found or not verifiable (no record): Guavaween (guavaween.com is a parked domain; no current organizer page found), John's Pass Seafood Festival (its domain shows "Coming Soon"), Cigar Heritage Festival and Ybor City Saturday Market (sites down), Plant City Pig Jam (parked domain), Lunar New Year events and St. Patrick's parades in St. Pete or Dunedin (no source found once search was exhausted), Winter Pride St. Pete, St. Pete and Clearwater lighted boat parades, Festival of States (a search summary said the parade was retired in 2014; not verified), Pasco, Manatee and Sarasota county fairs (2027 dates "coming soon"), Florida Manatee Festival, Brooksville Raid, Cortez Commercial Fishing Festival, Sarasota Chalk Festival (sites unreadable or no dates), Howard Alan art festivals (artfestival.com returned 526).
- Minor recurring items (fitness classes, homeschool workshops, comedy dates) were skipped.

## Open questions for the verifier
- Epiphany (2027-01-06) is tentative: the cathedral says the feast is celebrated on January 6th but has not posted a 2027 schedule.
- Bay Area Renaissance Festival is tentative: bayarearenfest.com returns a captcha; dates come from two fair directories.
- Mainsail's own site calls 2027 both the 51st and the 52nd festival.
- Florida State Fair hours list ends with "February 15, 2026" (a typo for 2027). The Strawberry Festival hours heading still says 2026.
- Hondo Rodeo Fest's own page gives no year; the year comes from Visit Tampa Bay.
- SPIFFS 2027: which of Mar 4-6 is the public day is not posted.
- Area choices to confirm: Run For Us 5K at Al Lopez Park (west-tampa vs north-tampa), Pinellas Park events (largo), Riverview (brandon), Dover (plant-city), Lakewood Ranch (bradenton-anna-maria), Tampa Greek Festival (hyde-park).
- Several series cite Visit St. Pete-Clearwater or Visit Tampa Bay because the organizer site blocked reads (Sea-Blues, St. Pete Pride dates, Saturday Morning Market, Collard Green Festival, Comic Convention, Alafia boat parade, Hyde Park Fresh Market); Tampa Pride cites a 2025 news article.
- 66 series exceeds the 30-50 target; the craft-fair and market series (Corey Area, Sponge Docks craft, Gulfport Tuesday market, Safety Harbor Sunday market and 3rd Friday) can be dropped if the calendar should hold only signature events.
- Shared place ids used: bayshore-boulevard, sparkman-wharf, julian-b-lane-riverfront-park, curtis-hixon-waterfront-park, tampa-riverwalk, florida-state-fairgrounds, florida-strawberry-festival-grounds, raymond-james-stadium, tampa-convention-center, busch-gardens-tampa-bay, ybor-city-historic-district, hyde-park-village, williams-park, vinoy-park, straub-park, st-pete-pier, pier-60, sponge-docks-tarpon-springs.


## Verification (2026-09-27)

Adversarial pass over all 113 records (47 events, 66 series). Every source_url, url, quote_source and also_source (141 URLs) was re-fetched with curl and saved as text; pages that block curl or render with JavaScript (Busch Gardens, Visit St. Pete-Clearwater, tbcgf.org, sunscreenfilmfestival.com, the St. Pete MLK page, bayarearenfest.com, tampapride.org) were read with WebFetch. Every description and quote was string-matched against the page text (whitespace and quote style normalized): all matched except Tampa Riverfest 2027's description (removed, below); the Strawberry Festival description differs from its page only by a dropped registered-trademark sign. Dates, times, prices, places and each summary claim were checked by hand against the pages. WebSearch was unavailable (the shared 200-call budget was already spent), so discovery used organizer sites, the Visit St. Pete-Clearwater winter/spring pages, Visit Tampa Bay's Gasparilla pages, the Paragon and Hot Works show lists, the SIK schedule and city calendars.

**Fixed (28 records):**
- Unsupported text removed or corrected: Tampa Riverfest 2027's description and is_free (attributed to a Visit Florida listing that has neither; the series also lost "free"); "parades", "strawberry shortcake" and "country and pop" from the Strawberry Festival summaries; "juried" from the three Hot Works shows (their pages do not say it); "leads the parade" from Pirate Fest; "marching bands, floats" and the name "MLK Dream Big Weekend" from the St. Pete MLK records; "costumed walking parade" from GeckoFest; "street festival" and "volunteer-led" from St. Pete Pride; "kumquat foods and drinks" from the Kumquat Festival; "Sarasota County" from the Sarasota Medieval Fair (Mallaranny Farms is in Myakka City, Manatee County).
- Wrong facts: the Tampa Bay Blues Festival kick-off party (Apr 8, 2027) is at the James Museum of Western & Wildlife Art, not the Palladium (the page has one stale Palladium line); Children's Gasparilla when_text "second to last Saturday of January" is on no page, now the dates; Pirate Fest series "late February or early March" replaced by the Feb 27, 2027 Outbound Voyage date.
- Sources upgraded to the organizer: Winter Village (Tampa Downtown Partnership: 10th season Nov 21, 2025-Jan 4, 2026, free entry, $17 skating; the record had only the City's generic list), Sunsets at Pier 60 (its own About page: nightly, 2 hours either side of sunset, Pier 60 Park, free), Fiesta Day (Ybor City Chamber), Tampa Bay Collard Green Festival (tbcgf.org), Alafia Lighted Boat Parade (alafiaboatparade.com); floridastatefair.com now redirects to floridastatefairgrounds.com (urls updated).
- Other: State Fair summaries rewritten from the event page's own list; Sant' Yago when_text notes that Visit Tampa Bay lists Feb 13, 2027 (the krewe page still shows 2026, so still no event record); Jazz Holiday and Sea-Blues linked to place sound-at-coachman-park; Sarasota Fine Art Show (Jan 9-10) gained its "Free Admission" cost; Taco Fest summary matched to the page.

**Removed:** none. No record was closed, duplicated or out of scope. Tampa Pride (a 2025 news article is the only readable source) and The Fourth at the St. Pete Pier (its page says "Friday, July 4th, 2026", but July 4, 2026 is a Saturday, and the footer says (c) 2025) are kept as series with the doubts in notes.

**Added (6 events):** The Fest @ Tampa Bay (Apr 17-18, 2027, Curtis Hixon; tentative because the body still says "April 2027 (details subject to change)"; the date is in tampabayfest.org's footer); 10th Tampa Bay Collard Green Festival (Feb 13, 2027, 9-4, St. Petersburg); 80th Fiesta Day, Ybor City (Feb 20, 2027, 11-5, free); 12th Gulfport Fine Arts Festival (Feb 13-14, 2027, Clymer Park, free); 22nd Festivals of Speed St. Petersburg car show (Feb 13, 2027, Vinoy Park, $15); 22nd Sunscreen Film Festival (Apr 29-May 2, 2027, Sundial AMC 12). Considered and not added: St. Armands Fine Art Festival (May 29-30, 2027, outside the window), Wellen Park and Englewood/Punta Gorda Paragon shows (outside the region), Legends of Stuttgart at Coachman Park (a single-make car show), Gulfport Plein Air Festival (an artists' event).

**Coordinates:** the 24 event points were spot-checked against their matched features (Corey Ave, Spring Bayou, Sarasota Fairgrounds, St. Armands, Albert Whitted, Plant City census match re-run, Coquina Beach, Lakewood Ranch Main St, England Brothers Park, Dade City, Zephyrhills, Al Lopez Park, Derby Lane, Gulfport, Cotanchobee, Sutton Park, SUN 'n FUN, Sims Park, Manatee Ave); all sit in their areas. JD Hamel Park still has no geocoder match (Photon returns Bayfront Park about 300 m away), so those three Sarasota records stay without coordinates.

**Still open for the merge/QA:** Epiphany 2027 and the Renaissance Festival stay tentative (no 2027 schedule from the cathedral; bayarearenfest.com unreadable). No 2027 organizer date yet for Sant' Yago, Gasparilla Music Festival, Sea-Blues, Dunedin Highland Games, River O'Green, Tampa MLK Parade, Tampa Pride or Busch Gardens Food & Wine. Guavaween, John's Pass Seafood Festival, Lunar New Year and St. Patrick's parades outside Tampa remain unverified (no search available to find new organizer pages).
